title: Pulling inputs through an embedding
statement: Given a circuit tail with $m$ input coordinates and an injective map from $k$ coordinates into those $m$ coordinates, its pullback is a circuit tail on the $k$ coordinates: each layer's gate input sets, including the output layer's, are replaced by their preimages under the map.
hypotheses_covered: A circuit tail with $m$ input coordinates
An injective map from the $k$ coordinates to the $m$ coordinates
